findings.issue: No audit artifact covers database migration rollback testing — 26 migrations exist but zero have been tested for reversibility
findings.impact: Complete blind spot: if a production migration fails, there is no tested rollback path; PITR with data loss is the only documented option
findings.fix: Create migration reversal test runbook; add supabase db push --dry-run to CI; write down scripts for last 5 migrations as minimum

findings.issue: No artifact audits the apps/worker package — zero test coverage, no health endpoint, no observability, no deployment workflow
findings.impact: Worker failures completely invisible; jobs may silently fail without any operational signal
findings.fix: Add worker to audit scope: health endpoint, structured logging, basic metrics, test configuration

findings.issue: 7 separate prompts flag 'message list virtualization missing' (API, frontend, UX, accessibility, performance, chat UX, release gate) — significant overlap
findings.impact: Same finding counted 7 different ways; inflated finding count and effort estimates
findings.fix: Consolidate to 1 finding across all domains; track remediation progress once

findings.issue: 5 prompts flag 'no CSP nonce' — security audit, hardening ultra, principal audit, frontend UX gate, platform audit
findings.impact: Redundant tracking: same defense-in-depth gap counted 5 times
findings.fix: Consolidate to 1 finding; implement nonce-based CSP as single ticket

findings.issue: 4 prompts flag 'reaction routes missing membership check' — API contract audit, security audit, hardening ultra, platform audit
findings.impact: P0 cross-tenant vulnerability tracked 4 times instead of once
findings.fix: Consolidate: single P0 finding with fix priority: add requireChannelAccess to reaction routes

findings.issue: UX/UI prompts (5) cover frontend design system, accessibility, responsiveness. Feature prompts (16) cover implementation. Some overlap on chat input, virtual list, themes.
findings.impact: Effort estimation without deduplication double-counts implementation work
findings.fix: Merge UX design + feature implementation into unified find-fix tickets where UX audit identifies the gap and feature prompt specifies the implementation

findings.issue: Environment drift audit says 'Sentry DSN never set' while observability audit already tracks this — two prompts with same finding but different severities
findings.impact: Inconsistent severity for same issue reduces trust in severity model
findings.fix: Adopt highest severity across duplicates; normalize: missing error tracking without alert = P1

findings.issue: 52 prompts produced 63 run summaries across 7 directories — some runs contain single summaries, some contain 4 (reconciliation + principal + quality + frontend)
findings.impact: Run directory structure is inconsistent — some runs aggregate stages, others are single-stage
findings.fix: Standardize: each run should have at most one stage; merge runs that cover the same phase

findings.issue: Artifacts span 8 domains (api, database, security, environment, testing, frontend, ops, governance) but quality_confirmation stage has only 1 artifact
findings.impact: Quality confirmation stage underweighted in overall assessment
findings.fix: Add quality confirmation prompts for each domain: cross-service integration tests, error boundary coverage, graceful degradation verification

findings.issue: Some findings use 'endpoint', some use 'path', some use 'route' for the same field
findings.impact: Inconsistent field naming makes automated processing harder
findings.fix: Normalize all location references to 'endpoint' for API routes, 'file' for code, 'path' for config

findings.issue: No artifact explicitly audits the pnpm workspace configuration, turbo.json task graph, or monorepo build orchestration
findings.impact: Build pipeline health and task dependency correctness not validated
findings.fix: Add monorepo audit: verify turbo.json task dependencies match package.json scripts, no circular dependencies

findings.issue: 5 prompt outputs reference 'write to docs/audits/latest/' paths that don't exist — master orchestrator, threaded conversations, notification engine, RBAC, webhook plan files
findings.impact: Implementation plans referenced in prompt outputs but never written to disk
findings.fix: Write stub plan files to docs/audits/latest/ referencing the consolidated run outputs
